description: Verkehrsnetze (Schifffahrtswege) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gdi.bsh.de. INSPIRE theme Water Transport Network (shipping routes). The maritime data of the BSH for INSPIRE Transport Networks describe the water transport network for maritime navigation in the area of responsibility of the Federal Maritime and Hydrographic Agency (BSH) as well as its associated infrastructure facilities. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Transport Networks (Water Transport Network)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include identified by INSPIRE, INSPIRE, HVD, Transport networks, INSPIRE relevant, high-value dataset. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2024-06-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
